findings.title: Dead AutoLayout remains in coverage totals
findings.why_it_matters: The new comment and per-file thresholds present the report as scoped to production-reachable modules, but collectCoverageFrom still includes src/utils/AutoLayout.ts through src/**/*.ts. Aggregate coverage output therefore continues to count the dead module, so published totals do not represent the stated live-code scope and can drive misleading regressions or compensating tests for unreachable code.
findings.suggested_fix: Add !src/utils/AutoLayout.ts to collectCoverageFrom (and verify whether the likewise unimported AutoLayoutEnhanced.ts belongs to the same exclusion), then rerun the focused coverage command.
evidence: jest.config.js:36-40 collects every src/**/*.ts file except declarations and test-example.ts.
jest.config.js:44-46 says legacy AutoLayout is not counted as live coverage, but the diff adds no negative collectCoverageFrom pattern for it.
Repository search finds src/utils/AutoLayout.ts defining AutoLayout with no production import of that module.

findings.title: Disconnected layouts may overlap undetected
findings.why_it_matters: A regression that assigns alpha and bravo the same bounds, and likewise charlie and delta, still satisfies normalized determinism, the same-rank x assertions, and validateLayoutModel. The test would remain green while disconnected components render directly on top of one another, defeating the placement behavior named by the test.
findings.suggested_fix: Assert that the component nodes at each shared rank have disjoint vertical bounds (or compare complete component bounding boxes for non-overlap), while retaining the reorder determinism assertion.
evidence: tests/unit/core/LayoutEngine.test.ts:37 only proves reversed input yields the same normalized output; it does not prove that output is spatially usable.
tests/unit/core/LayoutEngine.test.ts:38-39 assert equal x coordinates for same-rank nodes but make no assertion about their y separation or bounding-box overlap.
validateLayoutModel checks structural and finite geometry invariants but does not reject overlapping node bounds, so line 40 does not close this gap.

residual_risks: The repository's aggregate test:all/check scripts invoke Jest without coverage collection, so these thresholds are enforced only when the explicit test:coverage or equivalent --coverage command runs.
testing_gaps: The disconnected-component case has no assertion that separately rooted components occupy non-overlapping geometry.
